Senses.Note: A mold is the pattern from which stock words and answers are reproduced. Chan speakers use it both for inherited models worth breaking and for replies stamped out without live handling.

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: A mold is the pattern from which stock words and answers are reproduced. Chan speakers use it both for inherited models worth breaking and for replies stamped out without live handling.
EvidenceBody: The ordinary casting mold becomes a public verdict on imitation: a phrase that merely drops from a mold is rejected as borrowed speech.
The witnesses differ over whether an old model is useful or deadening; the entry does not make every model defective.
